import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots for comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price distribution by sensor type (top left)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
sensor_order = df.groupby('sensor_type')['price_usd'].median().sort_values(ascending=False).index
sns.boxplot(data=df, y='sensor_type', x='price_usd', order=sensor_order, ax=ax1, palette='Set2')
ax1.set_xlabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Price Distribution by Sensor Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 2. Megapixels vs Price colored by sensor type (top middle to right)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1:])
for sensor in df['sensor_type'].unique():
    sensor_data = df[df['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax2.scatter(sensor_data['megapixels'], sensor_data['price_usd'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=30, label=sensor)
ax2.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Camera Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Sensor Type', fontsize=8, title_fontsize=9)
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 3. Camera evolution over years (middle left)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
yearly_stats = df.groupby('model_year').agg({
    'megapixels': 'mean',
    'price_usd': 'mean'
}).reset_index()
ax3_twin = ax3.twinx()
ax3.plot(yearly_stats['model_year'], yearly_stats['megapixels'], 
         marker='o', color='#2E86AB', linewidth=2, label='Avg Megapixels')
ax3_twin.plot(yearly_stats['model_year'], yearly_stats['price_usd'], 
              marker='s', color='#A23B72', linewidth=2, label='Avg Price')
ax3.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Avg Megapixels', fontsize=10, color='#2E86AB')
ax3_twin.set_ylabel('Avg Price (USD)', fontsize=10, color='#A23B72')
ax3.set_title('Camera Evolution Over Time', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#2E86AB')
ax3_twin.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#A23B72')
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 4. 4K capability distribution (middle center)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
video_4k = df['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(video_4k.values, labels=['No 4K', '4K Capable'], 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax4.set_title('4K Video Capability Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Top brands by count and avg price (middle right)
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
brand_stats = df.groupby('brand').agg({
    'brand': 'count',
    'price_usd': 'mean'
}).rename(columns={'brand': 'count'})
brand_stats = brand_stats.nlargest(8, 'count')
x_pos = np.arange(len(brand_stats))
bars = ax5.barh(x_pos, brand_stats['count'], color='skyblue', edgecolor='navy', alpha=0.7)
ax5.set_yticks(x_pos)
ax5.set_yticklabels(brand_stats.index, fontsize=9)
ax5.set_xlabel('Number of Models', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Top 8 Brands by Model Count', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Weight vs Price by body type (bottom left)
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
body_types = df['body_type'].unique()
for body in body_types[:5]:  # Limit to top 5 for clarity
    body_data = df[df['body_type'] == body]
    ax6.scatter(body_data['weight_grams'], body_data['price_usd'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=30, label=body)
ax6.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Price vs Weight by Body Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.legend(title='Body Type', fontsize=8, title_fontsize=9)
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 7. ISO performance distribution (bottom middle)
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
df['iso_category'] = pd.cut(df['max_iso'], bins=[0, 6400, 25600, 51200, 102400, float('inf')],
                             labels=['≤6400', '6401-25600', '25601-51200', '51201-102400', '>102400'])
iso_counts = df['iso_category'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax7.bar(range(len(iso_counts)), iso_counts.values, color='coral', edgecolor='darkred', alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_xticks(range(len(iso_counts)))
ax7.set_xticklabels(iso_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax7.set_xlabel('Max ISO Range', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Number of Cameras', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('ISO Performance Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 8. Lens mount distribution (bottom right)
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
lens_mount_counts = df['lens_mount'].value_counts().head(8)
ax8.barh(range(len(lens_mount_counts)), lens_mount_counts.values, 
         color='mediumseagreen', edgecolor='darkgreen', alpha=0.7)
ax8.set_yticks(range(len(lens_mount_counts)))
ax8.set_yticklabels(lens_mount_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax8.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Top Lens Mount Types', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

plt.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
